events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Test Support At 1,600 Points
events.description: The Malaysia stock market on Thursday snapped the two-day winning streak in which it had collected almost 10 points or 0.6 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,610-point plateau and the losses may accelerate on Friday.

events.title: Profit Taking Expected For Japan Stock Market
events.description: The Japan stock market has tracked higher in three straight sessions, rallying more than 2,450 points or 4 percent along the way. The Nikkei now sits just above the 64,650-point plateau although the rally may stall on Friday.

events.title: South Korea Industrial Output Jumps 9.0% In September
events.description: Industrial production in South Korea was up a seasonally adjusted 9.0 percent on month in September, Statistics Korea said on Friday - following the 4.6 percent decline in August.

events.title: South Korea Shares May Extend Thursday's Losses
events.description: The South Korea stock market on Thursday ended the two-day winning streak in which it had surged almost 550 points or 10 percent. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 5,940-point plateau and it may take further damage on Friday.

events.title: Japan Data, Rate Decision Due On Friday
events.description: The Bank of Japan will wrap up its monetary policy meeting on Friday and then announce its decision on interest rates, highlighting a busy for Asia-Pacific economic activity. The BoJ is expected to keep its benchmark lending rate unchanged at 1.25 percent.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Slides As Investors Parse Fed Rate Decision Amid Economic Data Releases
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value inched lower on Thursday as market participants continued to analyze yesterday's U.S. Federal Reserve's interest rate decision along with today's economic data releases amid U.S. outreach to Iran for discussing a framework for negotiations.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends On Strong Note
events.description: The Switzerland market ended on a strong note on Thursday after staying firm throughout the day's session, amid optimism about earnings and positive cues from other markets in Europe.

events.title: European Markets Close Higher As Investors React To Results
events.description: European stocks closed higher on Thursday as investors reacted to a slew of corporate earnings announcements and digested the monetary policy moves of the European Central Bank and the Federal Reserve.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Mixed As Investors React To Earnings
events.description: Canadian stocks are turning in a mixed performance on Thursday as investors react to a slew of corporate earnings announcements in addition to digesting the crucial U.S. PCE data.

events.title: ECB Holds Interest Rates Steady As Lagarde Decides To Leave
events.description: The European Central Bank left its key interest rates unchanged on Thursday, as expected, after raising them in September, and the chief Christine Lagarde revealed her decision to step down next year, as policymakers wait for the effect of the past moves amid surging inflationary pressures and study the impact of the turmoil in French bond yields.

events.title: U.S. Economic Growth Exceeds Estimates In Q3
events.description: Economic growth in the U.S. exceeded economist estimates in the third quarter of 2026, according to a report released by the Commerce Department on Thursday. The Commerce Department said real gross domestic product shot up by 3.4 percent in the third quarter after jumping by 2.2 percent in the second quarter. Economists had expected GDP to surge by 3.1 percent.

events.title: Xerox Q3 Loss Widens, Cuts Adj. Operating Profit View; Backs Revenue Outlook; Stock Down 39%
events.description: Shares of Xerox Holdings Corp. were losing around 39 percent in the morning trading on the NYSE after the company on Thursday announced a downward revision in fiscal 2026 adjusted operating income view, after reporting wider third-quarter loss. Further, the firm maintained annual revenue view, despite lower quarterly revenues. The company attributed that the headwinds affecting outlook...

events.title: U.S. Consumer Prices Increase In Line With Estimates In September
events.description: A closely watched report released by the Commerce Department on Thursday showed consumer prices in the U.S. increased in line with economist estimates in the month of September. The Commerce Department said its personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index climbed by 0.5 percent in September after rising by 0.3 in August. The increase matched expectations.
